title: Austerity: the IMF and the adjustment programmes
goal: Read what the IMF programmes asked governments to do and what supporters and critics said, using se.

items: I can say why governments turned to the IMF after 1982.
I can describe the main conditions of the adjustment programmes.
I can report what supporters and critics said about these programmes.
I can leave out who acts with *se*: *se recortó el gasto*, *se subieron los impuestos*.
